changeSet.author: welcome-home
changeSet.comment: The country a guest's attempt came from, as Cloudflare tells it: an ISO 3166 code, or T1 for Tor. Empty for attempts recorded before, or when it is not known.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE access_event ADD CONSTRAINT access_event_country_check CHECK (country ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]$');
